name: Gasthof Gemse
beschreibung: The Gasthof Gemse is located in the municipality of Prutz in the Tiroler Oberland. The house is in a quiet location and surrounded by the mountain landscape of the Tiroler Alpen. The Gasthof is run in a traditional style and offers simple but well-kept accommodation. Guests can try regional dishes in the in-house restaurant. The rooms are functionally furnished and have a bathroom and WC. A guest garden is available for use in summer. The surrounding area is suitable for hiking in summer and skiing in winter. Prutz is a central place in the Tiroler Oberland and a good base for excursions.
